description: The record of the context layer: chunking, retrieval, reranking, permissions, freshness, grounding and the eval gate, with the forces, alternatives and consequences behind them.
The implementable part of the decision: the measured retrieval variant, candidates and topK, where permissions are enforced, how fast the index follows the source, and the eval gate.
Retrieval variants measured on the same golden set with quality, latency and cost. The evidence that turns a preference into a decision.
The maximum delay before an edited, unpublished or deleted document stops being served, backed by an update mechanism that can meet it.
A metric and target, measured on a fixed golden set, that a retrieval change must meet before it ships.
